question: Is the within-word spelling structure compatible with the archived Latin/Italian reference and validation texts under stable bijective character substitutions that may depend on word length and position? This is a necessary-condition compatibility filter, not a decipherer or a meaning detector.
motivation: Phase18 position-dependent keys can fit synthetic ciphers, but phase19 message-free generators also show a final-position score gain. Phase22 boundary correction did not improve new transfers. Phase26 rules out rerunning unchanged phase25. Use a key-independent invariant before further key searches; do not revisit image attachment or claim 970 remaining documentary loci inspected.
timing: Protocol, code, input hashes and availability fixed locally before generation and all new entropy measurements. Literature on low Voynich entropy and earlier phase results are known. This is not external preregistration or a discovery of a previously unknown low-entropy phenomenon.
hypothesis: One literal EVA character corresponds to one plaintext character; spaces and word lengths are correct; each (word length, character position) has a fixed one-to-one alphabet mapping across the tested group. This includes the initial/final two-table families but permits a larger family. Word-dependent keys, deletions, inserted nulls, homophony, many-to-one conflation, ligature/verbose encodings and incorrect segmentation are outside this hypothesis.
invariant: For each length L in {4,5,6,7} and each adjacent position pair i,i+1, compute empirical H(X_i,X_{i+1}|L)-H(X_i|L), with no smoothing. Row/column alphabet permutations preserve both count multisets, so arbitrary fixed bijections at each L,i preserve every component exactly. T is the equal mean across positions within each length, then equal mean across the four lengths. H_position, the analogous mean of single-position entropy, is descriptive only. No word-boundary transitions, cross-word counts or optimizers.
sample_size: Exactly 150 word tokens of each length per packet: 600 words and 3300 characters. Token-occurrence samples, not unique word types. Finite-sample plug-in entropy is biased; equal counts limit this comparison but do not remove bias or its dependence on alphabet support. No p-value, universal language threshold or nominal error probability is claimed.
references: Twelve disjoint within-source packets from archived Caesar (Latin) and Inferno/Purgatorio (Italian), selected by fixed RNG independently within length. Their minimum and maximum T, expanded by exactly 0.20 bits at each side, define one operational compatibility band per reference language. These are empirical bands, not confidence intervals. Selection and the margin never change after results.
positive_validation: Six disjoint packets per language from archived Pliny and Paradiso. Each packet is retained plaintext and encrypted three ways with new independent random keys: initial-specific, final-specific and unrestricted length/position-specific permutations. Keys are saved separately and never supplied to the scorer. These 48 records represent only twelve base packets from two works, not 48 independent texts; Dante appears in both reference and validation books. No new author or analyst-blind corpus is claimed.

controls.word_shuffle: One complete-word permutation for each of the twelve validation packets. Destroys original passage order while preserving words and the statistic exactly. Does not remove lexical meaning or prove absence of every possible message.
controls.position_shuffle: Independently shuffle each exact-length character column of each validation packet. Preserve every position marginal exactly, destroy within-word dependencies. Twelve controls.
controls.markov1: Six generated packets per language. Fit an order-one character model separately at each exact length and position on that language's reference source only. First-character empirical marginal; subsequent empirical transition plus alpha=1 backoff to next-position marginal. No chosen target passage. Inherits language spelling statistics and may emit real words. Twelve controls, no parameter search.
controls.vowel_conflation: Map a,e,i,o,u to a in each validation packet; twelve noninvertible controls outside bijective hypothesis. No reading claim.
controls.suffix_null: Append one x to each plaintext word, then apply one random monoalphabetic permutation. Four sampled packets per language after insertion, so original lengths 3..6 become ciphertext lengths 4..7. Eight reversible known-message controls OUTSIDE the hypothesis. May overlap base validation source occurrences; not independent author data. Decode by inverse key then remove exactly the added final x, never all final x characters.
controls.timm: Six previously generated native outputs at seeds 81..86 from pinned TorstenTimm/SelfCitationTextgenerator a6ede2202dd7ad6285ce2c007bf22c2a0e7709b7, executed in phase24. Discard first 500 words and select one packet per output with a new fixed sampling seed. Raw outputs/configurations copied and hashed. No new Java execution or independent manuscript validation claimed. Rules inherit Voynich observations.

gates.mechanical: Before reference/control measurements, direct conditional-count formula, constants, 80 artificial bijections and 20 column-marginal shuffles must pass. On real control packets require all encryption/whole-word-shuffle invariants within 1e-12; position shuffles must preserve H_position within 1e-12. Any failure stops execution for diagnosis, without changing protocol to rescue a result.
gates.positive_coverage: At least 5/6 plaintext validation packets must lie within their own reference-language band, separately in BOTH languages. All encrypted variants must give the same classifications. If either language fails, do not measure the manuscript. Preserve failed controls and report calibration failure.
gates.interpretation: Controls outside the hypothesis and message-free generators are challenges to specificity, not compulsory rejections. Their acceptance or rejection never tunes the band. Any accepted generator or rejected reversible outside-family cipher prevents a meaning/no-message interpretation. Even perfect discrimination among these examples would not establish a language or key.

manuscript: Pinned raw ZL3b-n and IT2a-n; real P0/P1 loci only. Handle wrapped IVTFF lines and inline metadata; retain only literal [a-z]+ dot-delimited tokens, with interruptions separating segments. Reject every uncertain token without choosing alternatives or joining commas. Require numeric physical folio and known Currier A/B, section and attributed hand. Exclude f85/f86 together and unassigned fRos; no foldout pseudo-replication. All extraction exclusions and source line/locus IDs retained. This scope is separate from the label inventory.
partitions: Separate Currier A/B. Two physical-folio blocks by floor(folio_number/5) mod 2; recto, verso and panels stay together. Two disjoint packets per group/fold, 300 occurrences per length in total. ZL is primary; IT repeats the same rule as transcription sensitivity on the same object. Different transcription packets can overlap physical inscriptions and are not independent. No manuscript training or test split is analyst-unseen. Source metadata and actual sampled section/hand distributions are reported, without claiming that mixture is controlled away.
manuscript_rule: For each Currier group and each reference language, operational incompatibility requires all four ZL packets (two in each physical fold) outside the band on the SAME side. Otherwise report unresolved/compatible under this limited diagnostic, not language identification. Apply the rule unchanged to IT as sensitivity. No pooling of packet p-values, no significance claim or extrapolation to all texts in a language.
stop: One frozen measurement pass, no threshold/length/character-unit search. Any failed mechanical or positive gate stops before manuscript measurement. After permitted measurements, report every control, reference, packet and failure and stop. Further tokenization, segmentation or broader-language tests need a new explicit protocol before new measurements.
seeds: Reference 270001+language; validation 270101+language; encryption 271000+100*language+10*packet+family; word shuffle 272000+100*language+packet; position shuffle 273000+100*language+packet; Markov 274000+100*language+packet; suffix sampling 275000+language, encryption 276000+100*language+packet; Timm sampling 277000+replicate; manuscript 278000+100*transcription+10*group+fold. Language/transcription/group indices follow code order.
verification: Independent conditional-probability arithmetic and independent cipher inversion; inspect all sampling counts, nonoverlap within each source partition, preserved marginal histograms, frozen hashes and physical-fold allocation. Replay from source bytes in an isolated local copy. This verifies software only. External human/historical/linguistic confirmation remains absent.
preservation: Baseline commit 2a766dbd1644d2b278570b63df914b60cd8bdab9. Previous phases and atlas unchanged. No publication, push, deployment or external message.
